BiblicalUsage: This is joy, gladness, and it is named at the dedication of the house of God, when the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites kept the dedication with joy. The house is finished and the joy is the offering.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe joy belongs at the dedication, because the house God gives back is worth celebrating.
